snippet.title: Lazy River Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

Wishlist Lazy River, coming to Steam Early Access Summer 2027!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743290/Lazy_River/

Special thanks to the trailer performers!
libtron at https://twitch.tv/libtron
